description: Resources in scope for a Duo Agent Platform flow session. resource_type/resource_id/resource_web_url name the primary target the session was started against; the type-prefixed fields carry each resource in scope, including the target itself and any resource the trigger path resolves for it in one lookup.

resource_type.description: Type of the primary target the session was started against

resource_id.description: Identifier of the primary target. Project-scoped IID for work_item/merge_request, global ID for vulnerability/pipeline. Equal to the matching <resource_type>_id field for the types that have one; a vulnerability target has no type-prefixed fields, so resource_type/resource_id/resource_web_url carry it alone.

resource_web_url.description: Web URL of the primary target. Equal to the matching <resource_type>_web_url field for the types that have one.

pipeline_id.description: Global ID of the pipeline in scope; empty when there is none

pipeline_web_url.description: Web URL of the pipeline in scope; empty when there is none

pipeline_source_branch.description: The branch the pipeline ran on, can be the same as source_branch if triggered from a pipeline.

merge_request_id.description: IID of the merge request in scope, scoped to its own target project; empty when there is none. For a merge request from a fork, the target project can differ from the project the flow is running in: resolve by merge_request_web_url rather than assuming this IID is scoped to the flow's project.

merge_request_web_url.description: Web URL of the merge request in scope; empty when there is none

work_item_id.description: Project-scoped IID of the work item in scope; empty when there is none

work_item_web_url.description: Web URL of the work item in scope; empty when there is none
